# ADR-010 — Art direction

|---|---|
| Status | Conditional |

| RTM ids | EP-§3.4-25 |
| Sources | `ELEVATION.md#§3.4:L840-L843`, `docs/build/design/ART_DIRECTIONS.md`, `docs/build/design/ART_CREDITS.md`, `docs/build/design/PRINCIPLES.md` (LP-05) |

## Decision

Night Study is the conditional choice because the pitch contour is drawn in the text color from the tone marks, Andika carries the target line, Noto carries the UI, and no craft motif is on the Today frame.

The status is Conditional. EXT-14 has not returned. EXT-14 sign-off is open. Sign-off for Night Study, Ink Lesson, and Courtyard stays Pending.

## Options considered

| Option | For | Against | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Night Study (`night-study`) | The pitch contour is drawn in the text color from the tone marks. Andika carries the target line. Noto carries the UI. No craft motif is on the Today frame. Heroes: `docs/build/design/art/night-study-today-light.png`, `docs/build/design/art/night-study-today-dark.png`. | EXT-14 has not returned, so the choice stays Conditional and sign-off stays Pending. | Recorded as the conditional default until EXT-14 returns. |
| Ink Lesson (`ink-lesson`) | One indigo action on the cool neutral page. The greeting stays readable. | Ink Lesson is rejected for the default Today screen because it spends the one craft-motif surface on adire before EXT-14 returns. | An adire placement study would occupy the only motif surface with no consultant sign-off. |
| Courtyard (`courtyard`) | The Yoruba line is the image, set larger than the title, and no cloth is drawn. | Courtyard is rejected because the Today heroes draw no tone contour, and LP-05 says tone is a shape. | The default Today screen would have tone marks in the letters and no contour shape. |

## Sparing-use rule

An African craft motif may sit on at most one surface per screen, as unit or region identity, and never as stripes on every card. A motif is allowed only when the unit's region matches the tradition, with a credit line.

The traditions in §3.4 are adire, uli/nsibidi, kente, bogolan, Ndebele geometry, and Ethiopian tilf. The Today unit is a Yoruba morning greeting. Night Study draws no craft motif on that frame. A later unit may carry one matching tradition on one surface, and the credit line names the tradition or the contracted artist. No person is named in this ADR.

## G3 review

G3 lists the open consultant sign-off. EXT-14 sign-off is open for Night Study, Ink Lesson, and Courtyard. Each row above stays Pending. The consultant is not named.

## Consequences

The conditional direction for the default Today screen is Night Study. Ink Lesson and Courtyard stay rejected for the reasons in the options table. A later screen that uses a craft motif follows the sparing-use rule and records the credit line. This ADR stays Conditional while EXT-14 sign-off is open. `docs/build/DECISIONS.md` carries the same Conditional entry.

## Verification

A review of this file checks that the status is Conditional, the named direction is Night Study, both rejections are recorded with their reasons, the sparing-use rule is stated, and the open consultant sign-off is listed as Pending for Night Study, Ink Lesson, and Courtyard. No consultant name, quote, or licence is recorded.
